title: Red-Lit Figure with Motion Blur
coreRelationships: The figure's dark silhouette contrasts sharply with the vibrant, blurred background light.
The horizontal motion blur lines create a dynamic tension against the static pose of the figure.
The warm red and orange gradient dominates the scene, enveloping the figure and creating a moody atmosphere.
The gold jewelry on the figure provides a subtle, reflective highlight amidst the dark tones.
reuseFormula: Generate a dark, silhouetted human figure with long dreadlocks and gold jewelry, positioned against a vibrant red-to-orange gradient background. Apply a strong horizontal motion blur to the background, creating streaks of light. Overlay a small, black rectangular box with a white border in the bottom right corner, containing white, uppercase, condensed geometric sans-serif text 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' with tight tracking and leading.
